intro.title: Bounty Hunting - Head Hunt Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Each Head Hunt boss comes with a distinct weapon setup and a signature mechanic, and the gang they bring follows the same theme. This page lists every boss by group with their weapons, health, damage and resistances, plus the gang members and support wave that fight alongside them. Tick bosses off as you complete them.
intro.profiles: Bosses are grouped the same way as the Head Hunt Groups lifetime challenges. Tick a boss when you have killed it — ticking every boss in a group completes the group.
intro.mutations: Mutation effects used by bounty targets. One-star outlaws are named after theirs, and some Head Hunt bosses carry a forced mutation as part of their signature attack.
intro.mechanics: Head Hunt bosses share the following stats.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss across the bounty level range. Bosses on the same curve share a row.
intro.damage: Damage per hit from each boss's main weapon at the bottom and top of the bounty level range.
intro.support: Every Head Hunt also sends a support wave that fights alongside the boss and its gang.
intro.npcs: Each boss brings its own gang members, listed with the boss they belong to.

mutations.intro: Mutation effects used by bounty targets. One-star outlaws are named after theirs, and some Head Hunt bosses carry a forced mutation as part of their signature attack.

list.name: Chameleon
list.detail: Turns invisible while it stands still.

list.name: Freezing Touch
list.detail: Melee hits slow the target down.

list.name: Herd Mentality
list.detail: Weaker alone, stronger while grouped with its gang.

list.name: Plague Walker
list.detail: Emits a poison aura while it is sick.

list.name: Unstable Isotope
list.detail: Forced Unstable Isotope — can release a radiation burst when struck.
